prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one production-minded 2D pixel-art storefront sprite for HoloCrawl, a Hololive fan dungeon game based visually on Dungeon Crawl Stone Soup. ONE isolated storefront, true transparent background, no floor rectangle or scene, no words, no labels, no characters. Front facing, orthographic 2D wall-facing sprite with only a very shallow visible top ledge; NOT isometric, no perspective side building. Subject: a compact LIVE GOODS SHOP ENTRANCE, glass double doors in center, two small shop windows, a modest projecting charcoal canopy, a simple cyan-and-pink three-slash illuminated sign above the door, one small star accent. Inspired by the cheerful entrance forms and pastel accent signage of Hololive Dreams' Dream Park, redesigned as a grounded slightly weathered concert-district shop in a dim concrete city. Main structure dark warm gray concrete and muted brown masonry, dark charcoal outer pixel outline, cyan and dusty pink ONLY as restrained sign and thin trim accents; warm little door lights. No amusement-park castle roof, no floating symbols, no heavy damage, no giant neon glow. Readability at logical 96 pixels wide by 64 pixels high: intentionally few large readable pixel shapes, approx 24-color palette, clearly stepped pixels, compact old roguelike tile sprite like DCSS. Render as a clean nearest-neighbor enlarged low-resolution sprite, not detailed illustration made to look pixelated. At most a few broad surface marks; no noise/dithering or subpixel gradients. Entire silhouette within image, flat bottom edge, designed to occupy three 32px wall cells and extend into the solid wall above. Strong clear silhouette and entrance readable after reduction to 96x64. True RGBA transparent background, no checkerboard, no ground shadow outside the sprite.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE isolated 2D low-resolution pixel-art merchandise SHOP FRONT for HoloCrawl Hololive fan dungeon game in the visual scale of Dungeon Crawl Stone Soup. True transparent background, NO words, NO labels, NO people, NO map or floor. Front orthographic elevation, a narrow top ledge visible at most, NOT isometric. A compact GOODS BOUTIQUE storefront: broad recessed illuminated display window with three very simple colorful standee silhouettes and two folded T-shirt stacks on its lower shelf, a narrow glass entrance at one side, small rounded striped cyan/dusty-pink canvas awning above, one simple geometric star sign on charcoal fascia. Use the welcoming amusement-park storefront proportions of Hololive Dreams Dream Park as inspiration, but blend into an aged concrete city outside a concert venue. Dark warm gray concrete lintel and brown masonry jambs, steel window frame, charcoal pixel outlines, restrained violet/cyan/pink display accents and soft warm shelf lights. Frame must end in solid masonry side posts so adjacent wall tiles can join naturally. No floating decoration, no ornate fantasy architecture, no large neon bloom, no sidewalk clutter. Logical native sprite 96x64 pixels, three 32px wall cells wide; pixel art with intentionally chunky sparse shapes, 24-32 colors, hard stepped edges, no smooth painting, no dense microtexture, no dithering. Render that low-res design enlarged with nearest-neighbor pixels. Keep window objects readable simple icons rather than intricate portraits. Entire silhouette visible, flat base, no cast shadow outside the building, genuine transparent alpha background, no checkerboard.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE isolated compact 2D pixel-art cafe storefront for HoloCrawl, a Hololive-themed roguelike with Dungeon Crawl Stone Soup sized terrain tiles. A small TAKEAWAY CAFE COUNTER with a narrow glass door, one service window, a short rounded cream-and-muted-coral awning, a small pixel coffee-cup symbol with one cyan star on a charcoal sign, warm interior window light. Inspiration: cheerful practical small facilities of Hololive Dreams' Dream Park, adapted to a slightly worn concert district in a dark concrete city. Structure dark warm-gray concrete/brown masonry and dark metal framing; restrained cream/coral/cyan accents concentrated in awning and sign. Solid rectangular side jambs that can meet adjoining existing masonry walls; no freestanding furniture, no outdoor table, no flowers spilling onto paths, no floor plane. Front-facing orthographic sprite, no isometric perspective, no side building, only a subtle narrow top ledge. Logical sprite exactly 96px wide and 64px high, chunky intentional old-school tile pixel art, 24-32 colors, distinct dark outline, broad readable door and window shapes, no text/letters/characters, no dense photoreal texture, no dithering, no subpixel gradients. Produce a nearest-neighbor enlarged presentation of this small logical sprite, not high-res illustration. All subject visible with a level bottom edge. TRUE TRANSPARENT background with alpha, no checkerboard and no external shadow.
production: Alpha crop, area reduction and 28-colour export with existing project PixelReducer; crisp 96x64 PNG. Originals retained.
